races.title: PricedUp Bet 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: It was encouraging COOLTOBECARELESS backed up his impressive Chepstow win with a solid third in a Grade 2 at Cheltenham just 2 weeks later and, with that form proving strong, he looks more than up to defying a penalty back in lesser company. Stars Aligning and Louxor de Grugy have both shown promise in bumpers and their pedigrees point to them doing even better over hurdles, while Keeptheflagflying is also of interest on his Rules debut. COOLTOBECARELESS (IRE) STARS ALIGNING LOUXOR DE GRUGY (FR)

races.title: Aubrey Bealby ABH Tipster Champion Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Not the easiest race to assess but CHATTY GIRL showed some promise on her first start in this sphere at Fontwell and can build on it on the back of a breathing operation to add to her debut bumper success. The returning Ahanaglogh could emerge as the main danger for his in-form yard, with Natus Vincere and Dance Rules also worth a look. CHATTY GIRL (IRE) AHANAGLOGH (IRE) NATUS VINCERE (IRE)

races.title: PricedUp Bet Handicap Chase
races.verdict: JUKEBOX D'EDDY was in top form when last seen in the spring and having gone well fresh before, Tom Gretton's 7-y-o gets the nod to pick up from where he left off. Jimmyjeroo was a bit laboured at Huntingdon last month but should reapplied cheekpieces spark him back to life, he's put forward as the main threat from a reduced mark. Glengolly and Brother Boris can fight out third. JUKEBOX D'EDDY (FR) JIMMYJEROO GLENGOLLY

races.title: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CAYENNE shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on his debut at Newcastle last month and it's reasonable to believe he'll last longer with that experience under his belt, making him an appealing candidate with that form already franked. Nevada Samba did well to make a winning debut at Wincanton in March considering his greenness and has to be feared under a penalty, while Monjeu de Chaillac and Micky Haller have both joined top yards after winning their sole outing in points. CAYENNE NEVADA SAMBA MONJEU DE CHAILLAC (FR)
